intro: The Alessa is built for big entertainment. A smooth, curved design, hidden storage, & built-in wire management make it perfect for keeping your space stylish, clutter-free,& ready for movie nights.

features.title: Fits TVs up to 70 inches
features.text: Designed for bigger entertainment setups, our unit holds TVs up to 70 inches, giving you the perfect spot for movie nights, gaming, or watching your favourite shows.

features.title: Smooth curved design for a modern look
features.text: Sleek, rounded edges add a stylish touch that makes your space feel polished without looking bulky or outdated.

features.title: No more messy cables
features.text: Built-in wire management keeps cables out of sight, so your setup stays clean, organised, and free from tangled cords.

features.title: Spacious top and storage
features.text: Plenty of surface space for your TV and décor, plus hidden storage to keep remotes, gaming consoles, and other essentials neatly tucked away.

features.title: Premium two-tone finish for a stylish touch
features.text: A mix of warm wood and crisp white creates a clean, modern look that blends easily with different home styles.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
